Set in a peaceful, tree-lined street, the home enjoys an enviable location close to Strathfield Village, Strathfield train station, bus routes, parks, schools, cafés, restaurants and shopping, with easy access to Concord and Burwood. Positioned in one of Cremorne Point's most desirable harbourside pockets, this well-proportioned two-bedroom apartment combines classic character with a relaxed Lower North Shore lifestyle. Set within an Art Deco building, the apartment offers comfortable, low-maintenance living with generous proportions and plenty of natural appeal. Ideally suited to professionals, couples or those looking to enjoy the convenience and lifestyle of this tightly held peninsula location.
